summary: Elbit Systems Ltd. filed Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that its U.S. subsidiary received multiple awards from U.S. Customs and Border Protection totaling over $370 million for national security work through May 2029. This is a routine contract win disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is involved. The filing is an ordinary current report of business developments.
